result.title: Largest origami number - Guinness World Records
result.content: The largest origami number consists of 6,455 fish and was achieved by Himeji City Kyokuyo Elementary School (Japan) in Himeji, Hyogo, Japan, on 27 September 2024. The attempt took place to celebrate the school's 150th anniversary. The number created by the school was 150. Records change on a daily ...

result.title: Largest display of origami dolphins - Guinness World Records
result.content: The largest display of origami dolphins is 2,701, and was achieved by Charles Violin (Canada) in Hamilton, Ontario, Canada, on 29 March 2026. Charles has always wanted a Guinness World Records title and knew this would be a fun record to attempt. His total (2,701) is the product of two prime numbers and combines this attempt with his love of math.
